release_notes: ISOS-L-1 and ISOS-V-1 stability protocols with T80/T95/T_S/Ts80 metrics and crash recovery; Keithley 2600 (TSP) support; automatic shutter control; Light-Intensity J-V mode; hardware-free simulator. J-V: open-contact warning, optional REV->FWD scan order, and the illumination is now saved in every file and shown in the Data Viewer. This version needs a new library (scipy): please install it with the installer from the release page, not in place.
